events.title: Demo 1.17 - Languages, Replay button, Animations
events.summary: We've once again decided to bring many of the improvements from the full game to the demo! events.title: Thinky Awards - Nominated for Most Anticipated Game
events.summary: We're excited to share that Trifolium has been nominated for Most Anticipated Game at the Thinky Awards!The winner is decided by a public vote, so if you'd like to support us, you can vote until 4 January on https://thinkygames.com/events/awards/ (requires a Thinky Games account).A lot of players use Thinky Games to discover great puzzle games among the many released each year, so winning an award would really help bring more eyes to Trifolium. Thank you so much for your support!

events.title: Demo 1.15 - Mac & Controller Support
events.summary: Added Mac build.Added basic controller support.Movement inputs now follow the camera's rotation, and the camera no longer snaps back when you move.Holding undo now pauses for 0.5s at the start of levels.Made small tweaks to 2 levels.Note: These level changes required resetting save files. If you'd like to continue playing the old version with your previous save, you can roll back to version 1.14 using this beta access code: 3HcgMuzHTReEt8e

events.title: Demo 1.09 - Update Notes
events.summary: Thank you all for the warm response to our demo launch last week! Here's the first round of fixes based on your feedback. Changed input repeat speed when holding down a movement key or undo. Changed the axis of camera rotation. You can now also use the middle mouse button to rotate. Added a visual indicator showing where a previous solution will be replayed. Added a different visual indicator if the door does not open because *that* condition is not satisfied.
